title: Partial Decimal-to-BCD Encoder (Digits 0-3)
description: Construct a partial Decimal-to-BCD encoder that takes 4 active-HIGH inputs representing decimal digits D0, D1, D2, D3 and produces a 2-bit output (B1, B0). Assume only one input digit is active at any time.
author: Ritaz, Mysha
hints: Determine which digits make each output bit HIGH: B0 = D1 + D3.
Determine B1 logic: B1 = D2 + D3.
Implement both OR expressions using gates from a single 7432 IC.
